samples.summary: New link-trailing-edge guard is bolted onto `clearInlineFormatting` only; every other caller of `applyStyleImpl`'s collapsed-caret branch still re-arms the link from the caret style
samples.evidence: `applyStyleImpl` (editor.ts:1170) stores `pending.set({ ...getSelectionStyleImpl(), ...style }, cursor.position)`. `getSelectionStyleImpl()` is the raw caret style, which at a link's trailing edge is the link run's style **including `href`**, and the prior pending state is NOT merged in — so any pending `href: undefined` armed by `exitLinkIfAtTrailingEdge` is discarded. The diff patches only the `clearInlineFormatting` entry (editor.ts:3364-3372). The bypassing call sites are `applyStyle: applyStyleImpl` (editor.ts:3342 — toolbar Bold/Italic/color/etc.) and `stepSelectionFontSizeImpl`'s collapsed branch (editor.ts:1283). Concretely: click the caret at the end of a hyperlink (mousedown clears pending), click toolbar Bold, type a character — the pending style carries the link's `href`, so `consumeForInsert` writes it onto the new text and the hyperlink silently grows. That is exactly the failure mode the new override exists to prevent, reachable through the sibling toolbar buttons. (Pre-existing shape, but it is the path around the new guard.)

samples.summary: New slides-only "Remove link" button drives a caret-only `removeLink`, so it silently does nothing for a selection whose caret is not touching a link
samples.evidence: `handleRemoveLink` (text-format-group.tsx:174-178) just calls `editor.removeLink?.()`, and both implementations are strictly caret-based: docs `text-box-editor.ts:1234-1244` and `editor.ts:3719-3725` do `findLinkRunAt(block, cursor.position.offset)` and `return` when it is undefined. The button is deliberately always enabled (comment at :168-173) and is, per the diff's own rationale, the ONLY way to drop an href in slides now that Clear formatting preserves links. But the natural gesture — select the text containing the link (or select-all: `TextEditor.selectAll` parks the cursor at the end of the last block, text-editor.ts:3408) and click Remove link — removes nothing when the caret does not land on/at the link run, with no feedback. The new test only passes because the link is the entire text-box content, so the end-of-content caret coincides with the link's trailing edge (edge-inclusive in `findLinkRunAt`).

samples.summary: The `prev.href === undefined` re-arm heuristic ignores the pending anchor, so a stale pending exit can inject `href: undefined` at a caret sitting inside a link
samples.evidence: Both new call sites decide `exitsLink` from `pending.get()` without checking that the pending *anchor* still matches `cursor.position` (text-editor.ts:3439-3442, editor.ts:3363-3367). Most caret moves clear pending (handleArrow/handleMouseDown/handleHome/... in text-editor.ts), but `EditorAPI.restoreLocalCursor` (editor.ts:4338-4352) moves the cursor and does not clear pending. With pending armed as `{ href: undefined }` (typing a space at a link trailing edge leaves it armed and re-anchored, pending-style.ts:41) and the caret subsequently repositioned inside a hyperlink, Cmd+\ / the toolbar button would write `{ ...CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE, href: undefined }` there, and the next typed character would punch an unlinked run into the middle of the link instead of inheriting it. Guarding on `isAtLinkTrailingEdge` alone, or additionally comparing the pending anchor, would remove the hazard.

verdict.reason: The described code is present and unguarded. editor.ts:1170 stores `pending.set({ ...getSelectionStyleImpl(), ...style }, cursor.position)` with no merge of the existing pending state, and pending-style.ts:22-24 confirms `set()` replaces rather than merges. caret-style.ts:93-115 shows the caret read returns the run's raw style, which at a link's trailing edge includes `href` (isAtLinkTrailingEdge, caret-style.ts:70-87, is exactly that position test). The new `href: undefined` override exists only in `clearInlineFormatting` (editor.ts:3362-3372); the sibling entries `applyStyle: applyStyleImpl` (editor.ts:3342) and `stepSelectionFontSizeImpl`'s collapsed branch (editor.ts:1283) reach the same collapsed branch without it. The asymmetry is corroborated by the keyboard path: TextEditor.toggleStyle (text-editor.ts:3465-3499) explicitly merges prior pending into the new pending, preserving an armed `href: undefined`, and TextEditor.clearFormatting (text-editor.ts:3439-3448) carries the same override — so only the toolbar applyStyle path drops the exit. The armed state is reachable in normal use: exitLinkIfAtTrailingEdge (text-editor.ts:5912-5917) arms it on Enter (2608/2641), space (981) and paste (4171), and pending survives splits/inserts (pending-style.ts:28-49), while plain-character insertion (text-editor.ts:983 -> docInsertText 628-633) never re-checks the trailing edge, so nothing downstream restores the wiped exit. No guard, unreachability, or scope objection applies; this is a state/logic correctness defect in my lane.

finding.summary: New slides-only "Remove link" button drives a caret-only `removeLink`, so it silently does nothing for a selection whose caret is not touching a link
finding.evidence: `handleRemoveLink` (text-format-group.tsx:174-178) just calls `editor.removeLink?.()`, and both implementations are strictly caret-based: docs `text-box-editor.ts:1234-1244` and `editor.ts:3719-3725` do `findLinkRunAt(block, cursor.position.offset)` and `return` when it is undefined. The button is deliberately always enabled (comment at :168-173) and is, per the diff's own rationale, the ONLY way to drop an href in slides now that Clear formatting preserves links. But the natural gesture — select the text containing the link (or select-all: `TextEditor.selectAll` parks the cursor at the end of the last block, text-editor.ts:3408) and click Remove link — removes nothing when the caret does not land on/at the link run, with no feedback. verdict.reason: Every element of the finding checks out in the repo. `handleRemoveLink` (packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/text-format-group.tsx:174-178) calls only `editor.removeLink?.()` and the button is rendered always-enabled (`:310-325`, `disabled={isDisabled}`), with the comment at `:168-173` deliberately declining a `getLinkAtCursor()` gate. Both implementations are caret-only: packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:1234-1248 and packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:3719-3737 both do `findLinkRunAt(block, cursor.position.offset)` and `return` when undefined; neither reads the selection range. The slides editor just delegates (packages/slides/src/view/editor/text-box-editor.ts:650-652). `findLinkRunAt` is edge-inclusive (packages/docs/src/view/link-run.ts:40-48), so an end-of-content caret only coincidentally hits a link that ends the content. `TextEditor.selectAll` (packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:3395-3413) sets a full-document selection but parks the caret at the end of the last block, so Cmd+A + Remove link is a silent no-op whenever the link is not at that end; likewise for any drag-selection extending past the link. This is slides' only href-removal entry point (text-edit-section.tsx:22-26, slides-view.tsx:745-750, showRemoveLink defaults false for docs at text-format-group.tsx:102), and I found no caller anywhere that repositions the caret into the link first — the docs link popover (docs-link-popover.tsx:154) is caret-on-link by construction and does not cover slides. Real, reachable in normal use, silent failure of the feature's stated purpose: no named refutation ground applies.

finding.summary: Toolbar "Clear formatting" (collapsed caret) still extends a hyperlink — the delta only fixed the Cmd+\ path
finding.evidence: `clearFormatting()` in text-editor.ts:3439-3448 was patched so a collapsed caret at a link's trailing edge re-arms `href: undefined`. The toolbar/API sibling was not. `EditorAPI.clearInlineFormatting` (editor.ts:3344-3350) calls `applyStyleImpl(CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE)`, and the collapsed branch of `applyStyleImpl` does `pending.set({ ...getSelectionStyleImpl(), ...style }, cursor.position)` (editor.ts:1168-1174). `getSelectionStyleImpl()` → `caretInlineStyle(doc, cursor.position)` returns the raw run style *including* `href` (model/caret-style.ts:71-78), and `CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE` no longer carries an `href` key (model/types.ts:300) so it cannot override it. Result: with the caret at the trailing edge of a link (e.g. right after `insertLink`, where `exitLinkIfAtTrailingEdge` had armed `href: undefined`), clicking Clear formatting overwrites pending with `href: '<url>'`, and the next typed character is written *into* the link — silently extending it. Before this PR the `href: undefined` inside `CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE` masked this. Same hazard, same caret, different entry point; the doc comment at text-editor.ts:3418 claims the button and shortcut behave identically, which is no longer true for a collapsed caret.

verdict.reason: The finding asserts that the toolbar/API sibling was left unpatched and simply calls `applyStyleImpl(CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE)`. It does not. `EditorAPI.clearInlineFormatting` at packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:3344-3373 computes `collapsed`, reads `pending.get()`, and sets `exitsLink = collapsed && (isAtLinkTrailingEdge(doc, cursor.position) || (prev && 'href' in prev && prev.href === undefined))`, then dispatches `{ ...CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE, href: undefined }` when `exitsLink` — the identical construction and identical disjunction used by the Cmd+\ path at text-editor.ts:3439-3448, off the same shared predicate imported at editor.ts:29 and defined at model/caret-style.ts:70-87 (whose own doc comment at :65-68 names both entry points as the reason it is shared). The override is effective through the collapsed branch at editor.ts:1170 (`pending.set({ ...getSelectionStyleImpl(), ...style })`) because the explicit `href: undefined` key is present in `style` and therefore wins over the caret-derived `href` — the claimed 'no href key so it cannot override' premise is false for this call. Both arms of the reviewer's scenario are covered: a caret right after `insertLink` (where exitLinkIfAtTrailingEdge, text-editor.ts:5913, armed `href: undefined`) hits the `prev.href === undefined` disjunct at editor.ts:3367, and a caret merely at a link's end hits `isAtLinkTrailingEdge` at editor.ts:3366. Grep confirms editor.ts:3344 is the sole implementation (editor.ts:102 is the interface declaration, :4451 a name list), so no unpatched sibling exists. Code not present as described.
